keys.causal_role: establish carrier root/support clock before object relation
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Carrier root travels right on a locomotion clock; no object/contact authority exists.
keys.name: TRAVEL_BASE

keys.causal_role: prepare hand path without interrupting root/support travel
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Root continues right; throwing side leads while foot exchange remains locomotor.
keys.name: UPPER_BODY_PREP

keys.causal_role: acquire a local hand-object constraint before release
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Object authority is local to A.hand_r; root authority remains A_LOCAL.
keys.name: HAND_OBJECT_ANCHOR

keys.causal_role: destroy hand constraint and transfer object to independent travel
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Custody changes A_HAND -> FREE at a hard causal join; carrier root does not pause.
keys.name: RELEASE_JOIN

keys.causal_role: make independent object path readable while carrier root keeps advancing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Object gains horizontal lead and slight rise; carrier root keeps its prior direction.
keys.name: FREE_SEPARATION

keys.causal_role: show upper-body recoil lag without surrendering root/support continuity
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Shoulders/throwing hand trail the root while free object advances on its own clock.
keys.name: CARRIER_RECOIL_LAG

keys.causal_role: separate object travel from carrier recovery timing
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Free object leads; carrier root keeps moving and upper body restacks.
keys.name: OBJECT_LEADS_ROOT

keys.causal_role: remove object from local relationship while locomotion remains authored
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Object exits local frame; root/support clock continues with no reverse custody.
keys.name: OBJECT_EXIT_RECOVERY

keys.causal_role: return to ordinary travel after object relation ends
keys.motion_arc_root_note: Carrier is fully back on locomotion clock; no contact/custody relationship remains.
keys.name: TRAVEL_RESTORED

minimal_maximal_principle: OBJECT RELEASE IS ORTHOGONAL TO ROOT MOTION: custody can transfer from hand to free object while the carrier support/root clock continues.

principles.anchors: Hand anchor changes object custody; feet continue locomotor support independently.
principles.approach: Carrier root is already in readable travel before the object event.
principles.causal_order: TRAVEL -> PREP -> HAND_OBJECT_ANCHOR -> RELEASE -> FREE_SEPARATION -> RECOIL_LAG -> OBJECT_LEADS -> OBJECT_EXIT -> TRAVEL_RESTORED
principles.contact_acquisition: A short-lived hand-object anchor is authored as the local custody join.
principles.lag: After release, carrier recovery lags behind the faster free object clock.
principles.leverage: Not established; no external leverage claim is made.
principles.opposing_arcs: Carrier root stays mostly lateral while free object takes its own forward/rising arc.
principles.recoil: Upper body may recoil/lag while root/support continues.
principles.recovery: Carrier restacks into travel after the object relation exits.
principles.release: Release destroys the hand-object constraint without stealing root authority.
principles.shared_center_force: Not established by this source; shared_center remains null rather than invented.
principles.transfer: Custody transfers A_HAND -> FREE at one decisive causal join.
